claims.text: Little Kulala lies on 27,000 hectares of the Kulala Wilderness Reserve.

findings.quote: Little Kulala lies on 27,000 hectares of the pristine Kulala Wilderness Reserve.

claims.text: The area lies in the south of the Namib Desert, in the Namib-Naukluft National Park, where salt and clay pans are surrounded by high red dunes.

findings.quote: In the south of Namibia’s ancient Namib Desert, in the Namib-Naukluft National Park, salt and clay pans are surrounded by high dunes, stained red by their iron oxide coating.

claims.text: Some 30 years ago Wilderness pushed to protect the landscape, returning the former goat farmland to its natural state.

findings.quote: Once upon a time, the farmland here was used for subsistence goat farming, with very little indigenous wildlife left.
Some 30 years ago Wilderness pushed to protect the ancient landscape, returning the land to its former glorious natural state.

claims.text: The camp's decor echoes the local geology, reflecting the surrounding grey and pink limestone.

findings.quote: Little Kulala’s décor echoes the local geology, reflecting the surrounding grey and pink limestone

claims.text: Each suite has a rooftop for private sundowners and suppers.

findings.quote: while your rooftop invites private sundowners and suppers.
as well as a roof deck looking out toward Sossuvlei

claims.text: Activities include nature walks and drives, e-bikes and low-impact quad bikes.

findings.quote: See the desert come alive on nature walks and drives, e-bikes, or low-impact quad bikes.

claims.text: Desert-adapted wildlife includes ostriches, springbok, gemsbok, black-backed jackals, bat-eared foxes, perhaps an aardwolf, and Namibia's endemic dune lark.

findings.quote: Spot desert-adapted wildlife such as ostriches, springbok, gemsbok, black-backed jackals, bat-eared foxes, perhaps an aardwolf, or Namibia’s endemic dune lark.

claims.text: Guided stargazing through the constellations is offered.

findings.quote: Be guided through the majestic constellations.

claims.text: Menus highlight indigenous produce such as Namibian dates, eembe fruit, venison, millet and local beans.

findings.quote: At Little Kulala our menus highlight indigenous produce. Sample Namibian dates, eembe fruit, venison, millet, and local beans.

claims.text: There is a wine cellar for a private dinner for two.

findings.quote: Retreat to the wine cellar for a romantic dinner for two.

claims.text: The fully inclusive rate covers accommodation, all meals, twice-daily camp activities, park fees, laundry and local drinks, except premium imported brands and champagne.

findings.quote: The fully inclusive rate covers your accommodation, all meals, twice-daily camp activities, park fees, laundry, and all local drinks with the exception of premium imported brands and champagne.

claims.text: An exclusive-use gate gives Little Kulala guests direct access to the Sossusvlei dunes and Dead Vlei.

findings.quote: An exclusive-use gate provides direct access to the renowned dunes of Sossusvlei and the evocative panoramas of Dead Vlei.
Wilderness guests can access the national park via a private gate, giving them a head start on the drive out to Dune 45, Big Daddy, and Deadvlei.

claims.text: Each suite has its own private pool.

findings.quote: Your suite’s private pool is where we’re sure to find you enjoying lazy afternoons
each room has a private plunge pool, too.

claims.text: A roll-out bed on the suite's shaded deck can be used for a siesta or a night's sleep outdoors.

findings.quote: A roll-out bed on your shaded deck is perfect for a siesta, or heavenly night’s sleep.

claims.text: Guests can climb the 300-metre red dunes and look over the Namib Sand Sea World Heritage Site.

findings.quote: Climb the 300-metre red dunes and gaze upon the famed Namib Sand Sea World Heritage Site.

claims.text: After-dark walks reveal creatures such as scorpions glowing under UV light.

findings.quote: After dark, discover another realm of the Namib. Walks reveal captivating creatures, such as scorpions aglow under UV light

claims.text: The camp is in a remote part of Namibia; the quickest way to reach it is by light aircraft with Wilderness Air.

findings.quote: the best and quickest way to reach this remote part of Namibia is by light aircraft with Wilderness Air

claims.text: Hot air balloon flights launch at dawn from near Sesriem, about 45 minutes from camp, and must be booked well in advance; they are subject to weather.

findings.quote: hot air balloon flights over the Namib Desert operate at dawn from near Sesriem, approximately 45 minutes from camp.
Balloon flights must be booked well in advance and are subject to weather
